# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 12 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_012_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 12

**12:1** And she made the purple and the scarlet and brought them to the priest. And the priest blessed her and said, "Mary, the Lord God has magnified your name, and you shall be blessed among all the generations of the earth."

**12:2** And Mary rejoiced and went to her kinswoman Elizabeth. And she knocked at the door. And when Elizabeth heard it, she set down the scarlet thread and ran to the door and opened it, and when she saw Mary she blessed her and said, "Whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me? For behold, that which is in me leaped and blessed you."

**12:3** And Mary forgot the mysteries which the angel Gabriel had told her, and she gazed up into heaven and said, "Who am I, Lord, that all the generations of the earth shall call me blessed?"

**12:4** And she remained three months with Elizabeth. Day by day her womb was growing, and Mary was afraid and went to her house and hid herself from the children of Israel. And she was sixteen years old when all these mysteries happened to her.
